## Authoring path

- [ ] Issue Form (Issue body is the source of truth — do not hand-edit the RFC file)
- [ ] Direct PR (RFC file is the source of truth)
- [ ] Notion-to-GitHub sync

## Checklist before requesting review

- [ ] PR title follows `RFC-XXXX: <title>` format
- [ ] RFC file frontmatter is complete (`rfc_id`, `title`, `author`, `status`, `date_created`, `team`)
- [ ] Impact Triage table filled in (every domain Yes/No + justification)
- [ ] `status:draft` removed and `status:open-for-review` applied when ready
- [ ] Lightweight RFC? Apply `rfc:lightweight` (Service Pack / non-safety only)

## CCB Decision (filled by CCB Chair at decision time)

- **Decision**: Pending | Accept | Reject | Defer
- **Decision date**:
- **Linked Change Control**: CC_YY_XX
